theater: 安納托利亞中部孔亞平原

battle.name: 第一次土埃戰爭
battle.theater: 安納托利亞中部孔亞平原
battle.brief: 一八三一年五月，易卜拉欣帕夏率埃及軍攻入敘利亞；一八三二年克萊斯一戰再勝，十二月二十一日在孔亞平原以炮兵壓垮大維齊爾穆斯塔法帕夏的鄂圖曼主力，奪火炮百餘。英國海軍介入，雙方在屈奇開納爾卡議和，埃及退出敘利亞而得世襲總督權。卡面火繩槍已退居二線，線列射程與炮兵密度才是定局的力量。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰雙方名義上仍同屬蘇丹：一八一五年《尊爾斐爾條約》之後，埃及行省由穆罕默德·阿里家族世襲治理，照例向蘇丹朝貢，卻自徵稅、自募兵、自訂軍制，實際上已是獨立的國家。鄂圖曼方面由蘇丹馬哈茂德二世執掌，兵權集中於首都的新式禁軍與各省常備師，總督與地方徵召兵分散在安納托利亞與魯米利亞各地，克里米亞、敘利亞、安納托利亞南部的守軍多由地方世襲頭人與非正規騎兵充當，裝備老舊，訓練與指揮體系各行其是。埃及方面統兵的是穆罕默德·阿里之子易卜拉欣帕夏，部隊以歐洲人訓練的尼扎姆線列步兵為骨幹，輔以阿爾巴尼式的非正規步兵、蘇丹黑人士兵與馬穆魯克、契爾克斯的騎兵，炮隊由法國與歐洲軍官按歐洲射擊法重整，火力密度與射擊紀律都在鄂圖曼之上。英國並未在陸上參戰，卻以地中海分艦隊直接左右戰局：海軍上將愛德華·科德林頓率旗艦亞細亞號與數艘巡防艦駛入達達尼爾海峽，監視停火並迫使雙方回到談判桌。俄國與奧地利自居調解者，只停留在文件上。
countriesEn: Formally, both sides still belonged to the same sultan. Under the Convention of Sèvres of 1815 the Egyptian province was administered by the governors of the Muhammad Ali family, who paid tribute to the sultan as a matter of form but levied taxes, raised troops and set their own military system; in practice it was an independent state. On the Ottoman side authority rested with Sultan Mahmud II. Military power was concentrated in the capital's new regiments and in the provincial garrison troops, while provincial governors and local levies were scattered across Anatolia and Rumelia, and the garrisons of Crimea, Syria and southern Anatolia were manned largely by hereditary notables and irregular horsemen with old equipment and command arrangements of their own. On the Egyptian side the army in the field was commanded by Ibrahim Pasha, son of Muhammad Ali. Its backbone was the European-drilled nizam line infantry, supported by Albanian-style irregular infantry, Sudanese battalions, and Mamluk and Circassian cavalry. The batteries had been reorganised by French and other European officers on the European system of gunnery, and their weight of fire and their rate of fire discipline both exceeded the Ottoman. Britain did not fight on land, yet decided the course of the war at sea: Admiral Sir Edward Codrington took the flagship Asia and a number of sloops into the Dardanelles, watched the armistice and forced both parties back to the negotiating table. Russia and Austria claimed the role of mediators but confined themselves to paper.
people: 穆罕默德·阿里是這場戰爭背後的推手，他用一八二〇年代在埃及建成的常備軍充當談判籌碼：一八三〇年蘇丹要他出兵對俄、對希臘，他兩度拒絕，蘇丹便視之為叛逆。易卜拉欣帕夏是前線統帥，自一八三一年春越境入敘利亞，到一八三二年冬打到孔亞，攻城的節奏、火炮的用法與騎兵的投入都由他調度，他也是最有理由把勝利變成永久佔領的人。鄂圖曼方面，大維齊爾穆斯塔法帕夏率軍迎戰，在孔亞被擊潰並陣亡；此前在克萊斯方向敗於同一支軍隊的是優素福帕夏。兩次失利之後，朝廷只能指望剛剛重建的新軍與列強的援助，蘇丹馬哈茂德二世本人則把希望放在歐洲顧問身上。英國方面，海軍上將愛德華·科德林頓是最有影響力的第三方人物，他以分艦隊封鎖海峽、扣留船隻作為壓力，斂旋出屈奇開納爾卡的協議文本，行動的節奏由他掌握。俄國外交官與普魯士觀察者毛奇在孔亞之役後才抵達君士坦丁堡，看到的已是一支剛被重創的帝國軍隊；毛奇隨後整編的炮兵，以及一八三五年起常駐的普魯士軍事使團，成了帝國此後十餘年炮兵現代化的骨幹。
peopleEn: Muhammad Ali was the man behind the war, and he used the standing army he had built in Egypt during the 1820s as his bargaining counter. In 1830 the sultan demanded that he send troops against Russia and against the Greeks; he refused twice, and the sultan read the refusal as rebellion. Ibrahim Pasha was the field commander: from the crossing into Syria in the spring of 1831 to the fighting outside Konya in the winter of 1832, the tempo of the sieges, the employment of the guns and the commitment of the cavalry were all his decisions, and he had the strongest reason of anyone to convert a victory into a permanent annexation. On the Ottoman side the Grand Vizier Mustafa Pasha led the army in the field, was broken at Konya and was killed there; the commander beaten by the same army months earlier at Klal was Yusuf Pasha. After two such defeats the court could rely on nothing but the army it had just rebuilt and on the help of the powers, and Sultan Mahmud II himself put his hopes in European advisers. On the British side, Admiral Sir Edward Codrington was the most influential third party: he used his squadron to close the straits and to hold ships as a lever, and the text that emerged from Küçük Kaynarca was his work, the tempo of the whole operation being his. Russian envoys and the Prussian observer Moltke reached Constantinople only after the battle of Konya, and found an imperial army freshly broken; the artillery organisation Moltke then built, and the Prussian military mission that became a permanent institution from 1835, were the backbone of the empire's artillery modernisation for the decade and more that followed.
kits: 卡面這件火繩槍是十六世紀初傳入西班牙的舊式火器：一五二〇年前後的西班牙火繩槍長約一公尺半，槍管後端有火繩盤與機括，發火要靠火繩的燃燒段壓下機括，風大、濕氣重或點火稍慢都會失手，射手還要在胸前懸著盛火藥的盆罐，列陣與補給的負擔極重。到一八三一年，這種槍早已不是歐洲軍隊的標準兵器：英國在一七〇七年之後轉用燧發滑膛步槍，埃及的尼扎姆線列步兵在一八二〇年代也已經換成燧發滑膛槍配刺刀。可火繩槍並未完全消失，它留在鄂圖曼帝國的省軍、地方守備隊與各類徵召兵手上，也留在埃及最初那批以鄂圖曼式操典編成的部隊與阿拉伯部落民兵手上。這些部隊在敘利亞戰線的清剿與守城中仍用得上，卻既不能與線列步兵對射，也承受不起密集炮火的考驗。真正決定孔亞戰局的是火炮與火槍隊的世代差：埃及軍的炮隊由歐洲軍官按歐洲射擊法重整，炮手成批訓練，射程與精度都高於對手；鄂圖曼炮隊數量較少，裝填與射擊都靠個人手藝，發射間隔長，火力一旦被壓住就難以恢復。騎兵方面，易卜拉欣手上有馬穆魯克與契爾克斯的輕騎，衝鋒銳利，但缺乏火炮掩護就難以衝散線列；後方補給靠駱駝隊、尼羅河航運與地中海沿岸的運輸船，遠征安納托利亞時線列部隊的糧秣主要靠海運上岸再轉駱駝。
kitsEn: The matchlock on this card is an old weapon that reached Spain in the early sixteenth century. A Spanish matchlock of about 1520 was a little under a metre and a half long, with a match pan and lock mechanism at the rear of the barrel; it fired by pressing down the burning end of a slow match, so that wind, damp or a slow pull of the trigger could waste the shot, and the musketeer also had to carry a priming pan of powder at his chest, which made the drill and the supply column a heavy burden. By 1831 this weapon was no longer the standard arm of any European army: Britain had turned to the flintlock smoothbore musket after 1707, and the Egyptian nizam line infantry had been rearmed with flintlock smoothbores and bayonets during the 1820s. But the matchlock had not vanished. It stayed in the hands of Ottoman provincial troops, of local garrisons and of the assorted levies, and in the hands of the first Egyptian units still drilled on Ottoman lines and of the Arab tribal levies. Those troops were still useful for clearance and for garrison duty along the Syrian lines, but they could neither stand the volleys of formed infantry nor survive a heavy bombardment. What decided the battle of Konya was artillery and the gap between generations of musket: the Egyptian batteries had been reorganised by European officers on the European system, their crews trained in batches, their range and their accuracy better than the enemy's; the Ottoman batteries were fewer, slow to load, dependent on individual craftsmanship, and once their fire was checked they could not resume. In the cavalry arm, Ibrahim had Mamluk and Circassian light horse that charged keenly but could not break formed infantry without the cover of guns. On the logistic side the army moved on camel caravans, on the Nile and by coastal shipping; when the columns pushed into Anatolia the bulk of the grain and ammunition for the line troops was landed from the sea and then transferred to camel.
tactics: 一八三一年五月起，易卜拉欣把整個戰區當成一條攻城線來打：步兵縱隊沿幼發拉底河與地中海東岸之間的高地推進，每到一處先用炮兵驅散守軍，或直接合圍，不必等城牆被突破，改以封鎖道路、斷糧迫降。奪下阿勒頗、大馬士革之後，他沒有讓部隊分散劫掠，而是維持一支集中可用的主力，解決每一處仍在抵抗的守軍之後再向下一個目標行進，這是鄂圖曼地方守軍最難應付的地方：分兵來打會被各個擊破，合兵而來又缺少足以對抗線列的炮兵。鄂圖曼方面則相反，援軍由各省零星抵達，優素福帕夏在克萊斯敗後，朝廷改以大維齊爾穆斯塔法帕夏集結主力直取埃及軍。孔亞之役的正面對峙在平原上展開：鄂圖曼軍在孔亞以西展開，埃及軍列陣於其對面，先以炮兵對射開場，鄂圖曼軍嘗試以密集隊形反覆衝擊線列，埃及軍靠刺刀與齊射把每次衝擊壓回去，同時把騎兵預置於兩翼，待鄂圖曼軍側翼與後方被迂迴的瞬間全面投入，潰勢一旦形成便再也收不回。戰後埃及軍攻入營地，鄂圖曼方面的火藥與輜重在火中損失慘重；海峽方面再由英國分艦隊封鎖航路，把殘餘部隊的補給與撤退同樣管住。
tacticsEn: From May 1831 Ibrahim fought the whole theatre as a single line of siege. The infantry columns pushed along the high ground between the Euphrates and the eastern Mediterranean, and at each objective the guns were first used to drive off the garrison, or the place was simply invested: rather than wait for the wall to be breached, the besiegers cut the road, starved the defenders and took their surrender. After Aleppo and Damascus had fallen he did not allow the troops to scatter for plunder, but kept a concentrated body that could be used at will, resolving each place still holding out before moving on to the next; that was what the Ottoman provincial garrisons found hardest to handle. To attack piecemeal and be beaten in detail; to concentrate and still lack the guns to meet a line of battle. The Ottomans had the opposite problem: reinforcements arrived province by province, and after Yusuf Pasha was beaten at Klal the court concentrated its main force under the Grand Vizier Mustafa Pasha and marched straight at the Egyptian army. The confrontation outside Konya was fought in the open plain. The Ottomans deployed west of the town, the Egyptians formed up opposite them, and the action opened with a duel of the batteries. The Ottoman infantry tried to break the line with repeated dense attacks; the Egyptian line met each attempt with bayonets and volleys, while the cavalry was held back at both wings and let loose the moment the Ottoman flank and rear were turned, and once the rout began it could not be recovered. After the fighting the Egyptians entered the Ottoman camp, where fire and the explosion of the ammunition and baggage stores completed the destruction of the defeated army. In the straits the British squadron closed the sea road, so that the remnants of the Ottoman army were equally shut off from supply and from retreat.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但各方記述出入頗大，引用時宜保留其說法而不必取其一。埃及軍沒有可靠的總數，各書多以「數萬」概括，孔亞戰役一線的兵員常被估為六萬上下，其中線列步兵約兩萬、騎兵約一萬五千，其餘為非正規步兵與徵召兵。鄂圖曼軍在孔亞的兵力多記為三萬至四萬，隨軍火炮約七十門至一百二十門，說法不一。結果是鄂圖曼方面的損失被記為二萬上下，另有大量被俘與隨軍失散的部隊，火炮逾百門被奪，軍營與火藥庫在戰後遭大火焚毀。克萊斯一戰在時間上早於孔亞約半年，鄂圖曼方面同樣損兵數千。進攻敘利亞的時間線清楚：五月底越境入敘利亞，夏秋之間取阿勒頗，同年秋季取大馬士革，翌年再取貝魯特、賽伊達與阿克。屈奇開納爾卡協議在孔亞之役後數日之內簽訂，文本上的日期用的是鄂圖曼曆法，換成公曆已是年底；其後埃及軍自敘利亞與安納托利亞撤退又用了數月。敘利亞的埃及佔領自一八三一年五月到一八四〇年七月，前後約九年。英國介入的規模有限，參與者是一支分艦隊，而非整支地中海艦隊。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, though accounts differ considerably and it is better to keep their disagreement visible than to pick one side. There is no reliable total for the Egyptian army; the books generally say tens of thousands. The force engaged around Konya is often put at about sixty thousand men, of whom perhaps twenty thousand were line infantry, fifteen thousand cavalry, and the remainder irregular infantry and levies. The Ottoman army at Konya is recorded at thirty to forty thousand men with somewhere between seventy and a hundred and twenty guns, the figures varying from source to source. The Ottoman losses are given as about twenty thousand men, with many more prisoners and stragglers; more than a hundred guns were taken, and the camp and the magazines were burned afterwards. The battle of Klal came about half a year before Konya and cost the Ottomans several thousand men. The chronology of the Syrian campaign is clear: the crossing into Syria at the end of May, the fall of Aleppo in the summer, the capture of Damascus in the autumn of the same year, and Beyrouth, Sidon and Acre in the year following. The Convention of Küçük Kaynarca was signed within days of the battle of Konya; the date on the document is in the Ottoman calendar and corresponds to the end of the year in the Gregorian reckoning, and the Egyptian withdrawal from Syria and Anatolia then took several months more. The Egyptian occupation of Syria lasted from May 1831 to July 1840, about nine years in all. The British intervention was limited in scale: it was a squadron, not the whole Mediterranean fleet.
cause: 起因是穆罕默德·阿里與蘇丹之間十年未解的權力糾葛。一八一五年《尊爾斐爾條約》把埃及行省交給穆罕默德·阿里家族世襲治理，他其後清剿馬穆魯克、討伐瓦哈比派的沙特勢力，用十多年把埃及改造成自己家族的地盤；一八二六年蘇丹馬哈茂德二世摧毀禁軍另建新軍，帝國的兵制換了面貌，埃及卻比帝國更早裝備歐洲式線列步兵與新式炮兵，這一差距在一八二七年納瓦里諾海戰後更形顯露：穆罕默德·阿里用來向蘇丹討價還價的地中海艦隊在那場海戰中同鄂圖曼艦隊一起被摧毀，籌碼瞬間歸零。直接引爆點是一八三〇年蘇丹要求穆罕默德·阿里出兵對付俄國與希臘人，他兩次拒絕；敘利亞的德魯茲人起義與一八三〇至三一年的敘利亞亂事又讓帝國相信埃及的邊境正在失控，蘇丹於是在自己不在首都的混亂裡決定用兵。歐洲方面的算計同樣重要：一八三〇年《倫敦議定書》把希臘的自治寫成既成事實，英國擔心穆罕默德·阿里佔據黎凡特後在地中海取得基地並重建艦隊，法國則在七月革命之後轉向支持埃及，摩里亞遠征便是明證。結果這場本屬蘇丹與其行省的內務，被英法兩國的算計推成了地中海的國際危機。
causeEn: The cause lay in the power struggle between Muhammad Ali and the sultan, unresolved for a decade. The Convention of Sèvres of 1815 left Egypt to the hereditary governors of the Muhammad Ali family, who then destroyed the Mamluk households, campaigned against the Wahhabi state in Arabia and spent more than ten years turning Egypt into a possession of their own house. In 1826 Mahmud II destroyed the Janissaries and built a new army, so that the empire changed its military system, but Egypt had armed itself with European line infantry and new-style batteries even earlier, and after the Battle of Navarino in 1827 that gap became plain: the Mediterranean fleet by which Muhammad Ali had bargained with the sultan had been destroyed together with the Ottoman fleet, and the bargaining counter vanished in a single afternoon. The immediate spark was the sultan's demand in 1830 that Muhammad Ali provide troops against Russia and against the Greeks, which he refused twice. The Druze rising in Syria and the disturbances of 1830-31 convinced the Porte that the Egyptian frontier was unravelling, and the sultan decided to use the army in the confusion of his own absence from the capital. The European calculations mattered as much. The London Protocol of 1830 wrote the autonomy of Greece into the record as a fait accompli; Britain feared that a Muhammad Ali holding the Levant would have a base in the Mediterranean and would rebuild a fleet; and France, after the July Revolution, turned to support Egypt, as the Morea expedition showed. A quarrel that belonged to the sultan and his own province was thus pushed by British and French calculations into an international crisis in the Mediterranean.
impact: 第一層在埃及：世襲總督權被寫進協議文本，穆罕默德·阿里家族的自治地位得到蘇丹的名義確認，敘利亞的埃及駐軍同時整編當地基督徒與德魯茲民兵，使馬穆魯克之外又多了可以徵發的兵力；此後數年埃及的常備軍與炮兵持續擴充，到一八三〇年代末已是地中海上最可觀的軍力之一，伊卜拉欣一八三三年初回國坐鎮埃及，這支軍隊直到一八四八年他病逝時仍是國家的柱石。第二層在鄂圖曼：孔亞之役暴露了帝國地方軍與中央新軍之間的落差，也讓蘇丹把希望放到歐洲顧問身上，普魯士軍事使團自一八三五年起駐在君士坦丁堡，重整炮兵與參謀制度，帝國炮兵此後數十年逐步擺脫鄂圖曼舊制。第三層在英國：科德林頓的分艦隊是英國第一次以武力介入鄂圖曼帝國內部事務，行動的經驗、汽船的調度與外交施壓的成算都被帶回倫敦寫進政策，東方的問題從此有了固定的介入模式。第四層在敘利亞：埃及佔領期間地方武裝被解除，徵兵與稅制重新整理，軍隊與地方社會的關係徹底改變，兩次土埃戰爭之間的九年因此成為矛盾累積的時期，帝國重新收回敘利亞時接手的並非原狀。
impactEn: The first layer falls on Egypt. The hereditary governorship was written into the text of the agreement, the autonomy of the Muhammad Ali family was confirmed in the sultan's name, and the Egyptian army in Syria drilled the local Christian and Druze levies as well, so that beyond the Mamluks there was a new body of men to be conscripted; through the following years the standing army and the batteries were expanded until, by the late 1830s, Egypt fielded one of the most considerable military forces in the Mediterranean, and that army, with Ibrahim back in Egypt from 1833, remained the pillar of the state until his death in 1848. The second layer falls on the Ottoman Empire. Konya exposed the gap between the imperial new regiments and the provincial levies, and the sultan turned his hopes to European advisers: the Prussian military mission established at Constantinople from 1835 reorganised the artillery and the staff system, and over the following decades the imperial artillery gradually left the old Ottoman system behind. The third layer falls on Britain. Codrington's squadron was the first time Britain used armed force inside the Ottoman Empire's own affairs; the experience of the operation, the handling of the steamers and the diplomatic results were all carried back to London and written into policy, and the Eastern Question acquired a fixed pattern of intervention. The fourth layer falls on Syria. Under the Egyptian occupation the local armed bodies were disarmed, conscription and taxation were reorganised, and the relation between the army and local society was completely altered; the nine years between the two wars were therefore a period in which grievances accumulated, and the empire did not recover a Syria in its former state.
result: 結果是埃及在戰場上全勝、在政治上止步。孔亞一役之後，埃及軍占據敘利亞全境並深入安納托利亞，鄂圖曼主力崩潰、大維齊爾陣亡，首都震動，朝廷一面重建軍隊，一面向英國求援。英國地中海分艦隊於同年年底抵達海峽，扣留船隻、封鎖海路，雙方在屈奇開納爾卡議定協議：埃及自敘利亞與安納托利亞撤軍，蘇丹確認穆罕默德·阿里家族對埃及的世襲總督權，伊卜拉欣回到埃及，敘利亞重回帝國控制，鄂圖曼艦隊亦告恢復。戰爭到此結束，但爭端並未了結：蘇丹後來再向穆罕默德·阿里索取敘利亞，於一八三九年重開戰事，那一場同樣以英國海軍與外交的干預收場；埃及的世襲總督權則一路延續到一八七九年英國出兵為止。對兵器史而言，這場戰爭也把火繩槍時代的遺產推到終點：線列步兵的齊射、馬穆魯克騎兵的衝鋒與新式炮兵的射擊法，決定了地中海戰區此後二十年的勝負，火繩槍只能留在徵召兵與省軍手裡當舊式裝備。
resultEn: The result was a complete military victory for Egypt and a political stop. After Konya the Egyptian army held the whole of Syria and had pushed deep into Anatolia; the Ottoman main army was broken and the Grand Vizier was dead, the capital was shaken, and the court rebuilt its troops and asked Britain for help. The British Mediterranean squadron reached the straits at the end of that year, held ships and closed the sea road, and the two sides came to terms at Küçük Kaynarca: the Egyptians withdrew from Syria and Anatolia, the Sultan confirmed the hereditary governorship of Egypt to the family of Muhammad Ali, Ibrahim returned to Egypt, Syria went back to the empire, and the Ottoman fleet was restored. There the war ended, but the quarrel did not. The sultan later demanded Syria of Muhammad Ali again and fought a second war in 1839, which was likewise settled by British sea power and by diplomacy; the hereditary governorship of Egypt ran on until British intervention in 1879. For the history of arms the war also marks the end of the matchlock era. The volley of formed infantry, the charge of the Mamluk horse and the shooting of the new-style batteries decided the Mediterranean theatre for the next twenty years, while the matchlock stayed in the hands of levies and provincial troops as old equipment.
